spots.name: Rock of Ages Lighthouse
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Mount Josephine

spots.name: Partridge Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
